summary.en: Time stops inside the picture while the camera keeps moving: the content brakes into a freeze, the camera orbits the frozen moment (or it is marked up, or each hit holds two frames), then time comes back and the content finishes.
summary.zh: 画面里的时间停住、镜头还在动：内容急刹进冻结，相机绕着冻住的瞬间转一圈（或在定格上圈注点题，或每次命中顿两帧），再恢复时间让内容长完。

fits: The one moment of a process worth looking at from the side (a spike, a peak); review and explain films that point at one thing (annotate); the weight of each landing in a combo (hit-stop).
notFor: Content with no motion of its own (nothing to freeze); films without a 3D camera (use mode annotate).

intent.en: "This moment is worth stopping time for": the content freezes while we look at it from the side or mark it up, so one instant of a process lands with weight.
intent.zh: “这一刻值得停下时间看”：内容冻住，镜头绕到侧面看或在上面圈注，过程中的一瞬被郑重点出来。

content.en: Wraps one time-driven painter (a chart growing, a list moving) and the moment to freeze; `annotate`: the focus point and a note ≤ 24 chars (Chinese ≤ 10 characters); `hit-stop`: the hit frames.
content.zh: 包住一块随时间变化的内容（生长的图表、移动的列表）并给出冻结时刻；`annotate` 版：焦点位置和一句 ≤ 24 字符（中文 ≤ 10 字）的批注；`hit-stop` 版：各次命中帧。

fits.zh: 过程中值得从侧面看一眼的那一刻（尖峰、峰值）；指着一件事讲的评审与讲解片（annotate）；连招里每次落地的分量（hit-stop）。

notFor.zh: 本身不动的内容（没东西可冻）；strip、split 风格（orbit 要动镜头，改用 annotate）。

en: One time-manipulator per shot: not with on-threes or another speed ramp; two remaps fight and read as a fault.
`hit-stop` must freeze the whole picture, background included; otherwise only that card seems to drop frames.
Pick by meaning: orbit is "stop to look", annotate is "stop to explain".
zh: 一个镜头只能有一个时间操纵者：别和 on-threes 或其他变速叠用，两套重映射打架读作故障。
`hit-stop` 要整个画面连背景一起停；否则只像那张卡掉帧。
按语义选：orbit 是“停下来看”，annotate 是“停下来讲”。

upstream.name: 冻结环绕
upstream.summary: 图表生长到一半全冻住，相机绕悬停的 UI 平面 rotateY 扫 55° 再回，时间恢复接着长完
upstream.use: 情绪节点（震撼/收束）的运镜语言；与 space-camera-moves 的"炫技大动作"互补——这两式动作小、情绪重

upstream.name: 连招计数
upstream.summary: 三卡接连砸入，每命中 = 顿帧 2f + 伤害数字上浮 + ×N 计数跳字逐次加码
upstream.use: 元素落位/撞击的"命中一瞬"——给砸入、撞停加游戏级手感；按强度阶梯选式

upstream.name: 定格圈注
upstream.summary: 帧号非线性 remap 的节奏手法——定格标注（流动→定格圈注→解冻）
upstream.use: 卡片流/长横移中把一个重点"停下给人看"；教学解说、评审语境
upstream.energy: 中高（速度反差本身即energy beat）
